item.title: Why Bridge Slippage Changes the Amount You Receive
item.description: Bridge slippage is the gap between a route’s quoted output and what arrives after execution; understand the quote, minimum received and timing before you approve.

item.title: Warren Challenges OCC’s Nine Crypto Trust Charters
item.description: Elizabeth Warren asked the OCC for records on nine crypto trust charters, challenging whether their planned custody, payments and stablecoin work fits federal law.
